note: The 1952 Enchiridion, Lasance 1906 and Key of Heaven 1901 agree on all 37 substantive words, their order and the antiphon boundary. The corpus adopts customary stress accents and ae ligatures from the established profile; the prayerbooks' coeli spelling is an orthographic accidental against the controlling caeli. The controlling 1952 comma after Surgere is retained; the other witnesses omit it, and Key of Heaven has a semicolon where the controlling text has a colon after populo. Merely line-initial Porta is lowercased. Advent and Christmas-season versicles, responses, collects, rubrics, indulgence matter and concluding prayers are excluded as distinct units.

adjudicated.ruling: Cæli follows the controlling Enchiridion's caeli and the corpus orthography profile, which represents ae with the ligature. The prayerbooks' coeli is the common oe spelling of the same word, not a substantive variant. Key of Heaven's full stop belongs to its line punctuation.
